title: 大语言模型是近似生存估计器
summary: 研究提出Survprompt框架，将结构化患者协变量转为临床文本提示，零样本让LLM预测生存时间。在MSK-CHORD和Providence两个泛癌队列上，前沿LLM的删失平均绝对误差接近专门训练的随机生存森林模型，部分癌种更优，但跨癌种和机构表现不稳定，风险区分能力（c-index）较弱。
summary_en: The study introduces Survprompt, a framework converting structured patient covariates into free-text clinical vignettes to prompt pre-trained LLMs for zero-shot survival prediction. Benchmarked on two pan-cancer cohorts (MSK-CHORD and Providence St. Joseph), frontier LLMs achieved censored mean absolute error within 10% of state-of-the-art random survival forests for several cancers, but showed inconsistent accuracy across cancer types and institutions and poor risk discrimination (lower c-index).
